Name: FS - Digimon Survive Attire
Author: Doragoun
Description:
[b][size=4]Overview[/size][/b]
As the short intro already says, this [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url] content pack includes eight shirts and two hats based on the outfits worn by the eight protagonists of the visual novel Digimon Survive. Each piece of clothing comes in [b]three different versions[/b]: One that's simply meant to resemble their in-game outfits as closely as possible, one whose color scheme is inspired by the respective human's Digimon partner and finally one that can be recolored to your liking.

To access the clothes, simply use the hand mirror added by Fashion Sense to equip and, if applicable, recolor your favorite.

If you want to read some semi-coherent rambling on thoughts behind the design and the design process itself, you'll probably be interested in the following spoiler:
[SPOILER][b]Takuma and Agumon[/b]
I have to say, I really like that hoodie – definitely something I'd wear IRL. However, there was only enough space for either the zipper, the pockets or the pullstrings - I ended up prioritizing the pockets as the yellow pullstrings would've made the whole thing look a bit weird. If you're desperately missing them, though, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16195]this mod[/url] might be for you. Finding proper colors for the Agumon version was honestly quite the endeavor – all the other partner 'mons have the decency of having at least two main colors while Agumon is literally just orange. I finally decided to use his eye color for the inside of the hood and have the rest of the outfit reference Greymon with the brown shoulder area (the mask/horns) and the blue pockets (the stripes).

[b]Aoi and Labramon[/b]
I don't have too much to say about this one to be honest – it's kinda funny that both Aoi and Labramon have basically the same color scheme, though. The pants for her alt color preview are brown to reference Labramon's Champion level form Dobermon's brown legs.

[b]Minoru and Falcomon[/b]
The collar... the freaking collar. T_T It turned out okay after a lot of work (and help), but it's probably still my least favorite shirt. One detail for the Falcomon version that's easily missed: The sleeves are green instead of brown to match Falcomon's wing feathers being green, too. I found it cute, heh.

[b]Saki and Floramon[/b]
The thing that started all this! Saki's design is very pleasant to the eye in my opinion, so I figured I'd see if I could replicate her jacket... and well, I kinda did. There was originally going to be a version without a hood, too, but I figured the one with the hood simply looked better, so I decided not to include them after all. Her Floramon version is as colorful as both the original jacket and Floramon herself – the red of the helmet thingy, the cream of her main body and the pink and purple of her flower arms were used for the jacket, the shirt, the hood and the pockets, respectively.

[b]Ryo and Kunemon[/b]
Getting the stripes right was hard and Airyn helped a lot with that. The jacket actually had a zipper for the longest time... but I ended up removing it because I thought it looked better and clearer without it. Sorry, zipper fans! Similarly to Floramon, I was able to use basically all of Kunemon's colors for the partner version: yellow body > jacket, blue legs > stripes, red belly > shirt under the jacket and black eyes(?) > stripes on the headband.

[b]Shuuji and Lopmon[/b]
Yay, it's the guy no one likes. You have to admit that's a cool jacket, though. Since Lopmon himself doesn't exactly have a lot of colors to choose from, I tried to get at least one reference to his (vaccine-type) Mega level Cherubimon in: The shirt (very light pink), the shirt's hem and the little tag (both yellow) are meant to look like its body.

[b]Kaito and Dracmon[/b]
This has to be one of the plainest shirts I've ever seen. I originally wanted to incorporate the red cuffs, but that would've meant making a whole new set of sleeves and the necessary "code" [i]scares [/i]me. If I had done that, though, the Dracmon version would've been great with the cuffs matching the red and green eyes in his hands... oh well. Instead, I ended up having a two-colored collar. The hem, meanwhile, references the green gem and the gold chain attached to his... back wings? All credit for the idea goes to Airyn!

[b]Miu and Syakomon[/b]
Oh boy, making the hat turned out to be biggest adventure making this mod had to offer. I think it turned out pretty good, though! While her hoodie has a purple zipper that I would've liked to include, doing that would've looked very weird with the purple line going from one end of the hoodie to the other. I originally also wanted to make her pouch, but decided against it as a 2x2 green blob of pixels would've looked weird and also hidden most of the actual hoodie behind it. The Syakomon version... hopefully doesn't look like a dragonfruit as much as it used to at this point because that was absolutely a problem I had. The hat in this version is black as a reference to Mermaimon, Syakomon's Ultimate level, and the pin has more or less the same light pink color as her Mega level MarineAngemon.

[b]Haru, Miyuki and the professor?[/b]
No. I frankly don't really like their designs much and didn't want to add three (or technically ten since Haru should probably get two alt colors) more shirts to the workload. Maybe if there's enough popular demand?[/SPOILER]
If you have any thoughts or problems you'd like to share, please leave a comment! Likewise, if you like the mod, please consider endorsing it – that vastly improves visibility and, more importantly, makes happy, hehe. Feel free to make any personal edits to any shirt or hat, but please don't just upload them without asking first.

[size=4][b]Requirements and Installation[/b][/size]
First things first, make sure you've installed Fashion Sense - without it, this mod won't work at all. If you have it, great! Simply download the zip file and extract it to your mods folder. Easy, right?
To uninstall, simply delete the folder named "[FS] Digimon Survive Attire" from your mods folder. Easy again, right?

[/b]Huge thanks go out to all the amazing friends I made on the SDV Discord who helped me along the way, gave advice and simply tolerated me while I busy fighting 8x8 pixel shirts.You're great!
